observations.name: Input measurements

observations.name: Filter heavy

observations.name: WHERE heavy
observations.sql: SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE package_weight_g >= 100 ORDER BY product_id

observations.name: Filter not-heavy
observations.sql: SELECT product_id, (NOT (package_weight_g >= 100)) AS result FROM products ORDER BY product_id

observations.name: WHERE not-heavy
observations.sql: SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE NOT (package_weight_g >= 100) ORDER BY product_id

observations.name: Filter both
observations.sql: SELECT product_id, (package_weight_g >= 100 AND product_id = 'P7') AS result FROM products ORDER BY product_id

observations.name: WHERE both
observations.sql: SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE package_weight_g >= 100 AND product_id = 'P7' ORDER BY product_id

observations.name: Filter either

observations.name: WHERE either
observations.sql: SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE package_weight_g >= 100 OR product_id = 'P7' ORDER BY product_id

observations.name: Calendar versus elapsed
observations.sql:
SELECT (timestamptz '2026-10-25 00:00+02' + interval '1 day')::text AS calendar,
    (timestamptz '2026-10-25 00:00+02' + interval '24 hours')::text AS elapsed,
    extract(epoch from ((timestamptz '2026-10-25 00:00+02' + interval '1 day') - timestamptz '2026-10-25 00:00+02'))/3600 AS hours

displayedSnippets.label: Compare division and conversion
displayedSnippets.sql:
SELECT (20 / 3)::numeric AS converted_after,
       20::numeric / 3   AS converted_before;
-- converted_after: 6
-- converted_before: 6.6666666666666667

displayedSnippets.label: Compare two representations of order 103's instant
Calendar and elapsed additions in Stockholm
displayedSnippets.sql:
SET TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm';
SELECT timestamptz '2026-10-25 00:00+02' + interval '1 day'
         AS next_calendar_day,
       timestamptz '2026-10-25 00:00+02' + interval '24 hours'
         AS after_24_hours;
-- next_calendar_day: 2026-10-26 00:00:00+01
-- after_24_hours:    2026-10-25 23:00:00+01

displayedSnippets.label: Derive order dates in an explicit business zone
displayedSnippets.sql:
SELECT order_id,
       (placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')::date
         AS business_date
FROM orders;
-- Order 103: 2026-10-20

displayedSnippets.label: A NULL inside an IN list
displayedSnippets.sql:
SELECT 65 IN (820, NULL)     AS is_in,
       65 NOT IN (820, NULL) AS is_not_in;
-- is_in: NULL (unknown)
-- is_not_in: NULL (unknown)

displayedSnippets.label: Compare recorded absence explicitly
displayedSnippets.sql:
SELECT NULL::integer = NULL::integer AS ordinary_equality,
       NULL::integer IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL::integer
         AS same_recorded_information;
-- ordinary_equality: NULL (unknown)
-- same_recorded_information: true

displayedSnippets.label: Label a missing weight without inventing a measurement
displayedSnippets.sql:
SELECT product_id,
       COALESCE(package_weight_g::text, 'Not yet measured')
         AS weight_label
FROM products;
-- P3: 65     P7: Not yet measured     P9: 820
